sections.title: <is-grid-layout>
sections.lede: Grid declarativo. Port del GridLayout.svelte de ISP: cells acepta un número o una track list CSS cruda.

blocks.html: Con cells-fit las celdas son max-content en vez de minmax(0, 1fr).

<is-grid-layout cells="3" cells-fit gap="0.5rem" justify="start" style="width:100%">
            <is-tag>corto</is-tag><is-tag>un poco más largo</is-tag><is-tag>x</is-tag>
          </is-grid-layout>

<is-grid-layout cells="12rem 1fr" gap="0.75rem" items="center" style="width:100%">
            <is-text color="neutral">Etiqueta</is-text>
            <is-input placeholder="valor"></is-input>
            <is-text color="neutral">Otra</is-text>
            <is-input placeholder="valor"></is-input>
          </is-grid-layout>

<is-grid-layout direction="row" cells="2" gap="0.5rem" style="width:100%">
            <is-card>fila 1 · col 1</is-card>
            <is-card>fila 2 · col 1</is-card>
            <is-card>fila 1 · col 2</is-card>
            <is-card>fila 2 · col 2</is-card>
          </is-grid-layout>
